question_origin: 100 assistant-authored document-grounded reference questions; NOT actual logged user questions; NOT independent human labels

chunking.gold: all chunks fully containing a preselected exact quote; may not be exhaustive

retrieval.query: verbatim natural-language question; no query rewrite, stemming or stopword tuning

arms.A: linear file-chunk keyword search: count unique query tokens present, then total occurrences; stable ID tie-break; no IDF
arms.B: SQLite FTS5 BM25 OR query + BGE-M3 exact cosine via NumPy, weighted RRF
arms.C: AIRust 0.4.4 BM25 + same BGE-M3 exact cosine, weighted RRF
arms.D: AIRust 0.4.4 BM25 alone; extra embedding ablation

lexical_input: NFKC lowercase Unicode alphanumeric tokens for all arms; no stopword removal

llm.format: schema object answer nullable string, citations array of IDs
llm.context: identical formatter and byte limit; no gold answers in prompts

order: 24 permutations x4 plus ABCD,DCBA,BADC,CDAB; each arm each position25 and pair precedence50/50
metrics: reference evidence hit@1/3/6 and reciprocal rank
predeclared answer fact checks (limited exactness proxy)
valid citation IDs and gold-evidence citations
retrieval latency warm repeated and embedding measured separately
end-to-end wall time, Ollama real prompt/generated/cached tokens
retriever RSS; common model RSS separate; index build time
limitations: references may be incomplete; source docs can be historical/inconsistent
single machine, single local LLM, one fixed configuration; no broad superiority claim
automatic answer checks do not replace independent human assessment
no feature tuning after retrieval results; any changed protocol starts a separate run
